title: Rhubarb extract attenuates periodontitis by modulating an MMP3-associated inflammatory-ferroptotic axis: Integrated multi-omics analysis and experimental validation.
authors: Hou, Yifei; Yan, Chongzheng; Zhao, Hongxu; Yang, Zihan; Li, Yijing; Lu, Xiamei; Yang, Aohua; Xu, Xinrui; Wu, Xinhui; Song, Xuan; Zhang, Jianing; Liu, Yi
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大黄提取物通过MMP3相关炎症-铁死亡轴缓解牙周炎，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是疾病药理而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Periodontitis is a chronic inflammatory disease characterized by dysregulated host immunity, oxidative injury, connective tissue breakdown, and alveolar bone loss. Rhubarb (Rhei Radix et Rhizoma) has anti-inflammatory and redox-modulating properties, but its therapeutic mechanism in periodontitis remains unclear. PURPOSE: This study investigated whether rhubarb extract alleviates periodontal inflammatory injury and explored the role of matrix metalloproteinase 3 (MMP3) in periodontitis and ferroptosis. METHODS: The rhubarb extract was profiled by UPLC-Q-TOF-MS. Network pharmacology, transcriptomics, and untargeted metabolomics were integrated to identify targets and pathways. LPS-stimulated human gingival fibroblasts (HGFs), MMP3 knockdown and overexpression, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, surface plasmon resonance (SPR), and a rat periodontitis model were used for mechanistic validation. RESULTS: The rhubarb extract contained anthraquinone derivatives. Integrated multiomics identified MMP3 as a rhubarb-responsive hub linked to inflammatory activation and ferroptosis-related metabolic disruption. Rhubarb extract inhibited LPS-induced NF-kappaB activation and cytokine production, restored the SLC7A11/GPX4 antioxidant defense axis, and suppressed ACSL4/LPCAT3-associated lipid remodeling. These effects were accompanied by reduced ROS generation, Fe(2)(+) accumulation, lipid peroxidation, and mitochondrial damage. MMP3 silencing partially mimicked the anti-ferroptotic effects of rhubarb extract, whereas MMP3 overexpression weakened its cytoprotective activity. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and SPR analyses supported direct interactions between representative rhubarb constituents and MMP3. In vivo, rhubarb extract reduced periodontal inflammation, collagen degradation, iron deposition, osteoclast formation, and alveolar bone loss. CONCLUSION: Rhubarb extract attenuates experimental periodontitis by suppressing inflammation, ferroptosis-related lipid peroxidation, and osteoclast-mediated bone resorption, partly through the modulation of an MMP3-associated inflammatory-ferroptotic axis.
abstract_zh: 背景：牙周炎是一种以宿主免疫失调、氧化损伤、结缔组织破坏和牙槽骨丧失为特征的慢性炎症性疾病。大黄（Rhei Radix et Rhizoma）具有抗炎和氧化还原调节特性，但其在牙周炎中的治疗机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究探讨大黄提取物是否缓解牙周炎性损伤，并探索基质金属蛋白酶3（MMP3）在牙周炎和铁死亡中的作用。方法：通过UPLC-Q-TOF-MS对大黄提取物进行成分分析。整合网络药理学、转录组学和非靶向代谢组学以识别靶点和通路。使用脂多糖（LPS）刺激的人牙龈成纤维细胞（HGFs）、MMP3敲低和过表达、分子对接、分子动力学模拟、表面等离子体共振（SPR）以及大鼠牙周炎模型进行机制验证。结果：大黄提取物含有蒽醌衍生物。整合多组学分析将MMP3鉴定为与炎症激活和铁死亡相关代谢紊乱相关的大黄响应枢纽。大黄提取物抑制LPS诱导的NF-kappaB激活和细胞因子产生，恢复SLC7A11/GPX4抗氧化防御轴，并抑制ACSL4/LPCAT3相关的脂质重塑。这些效应伴随ROS生成减少、Fe(2)(+)积累降低、脂质过氧化减轻和线粒体损伤缓解。MMP3沉默部分模拟了大黄提取物的抗铁死亡效应，而MMP3过表达削弱了其细胞保护活性。分子对接、分子动力学模拟和SPR分析支持大黄代表性成分与MMP3之间的直接相互作用。在体内，大黄提取物减少牙周炎症、胶原降解、铁沉积、破骨细胞形成和牙槽骨丧失。结论：大黄提取物通过抑制炎症、铁死亡相关脂质过氧化和破骨细胞介导的骨吸收来减轻实验性牙周炎，部分机制涉及调节MMP3相关的炎症-铁死亡轴。
